Templates.Name: Access Granted in Application
Templates.Subject: Access Granted to {AppName}
Templates.Body:
Hello {EmployeeName},

We confirm that you have been granted access to application '{AppName}' with role '{RoleName}'.

You can access the application directly at: {AppUrl}.

Change made by: {GrantedBy}.

Regards,
The {FromName} Team

Templates.Name: Access Revoked from Application
Templates.Subject: Access Revoked from {AppName}
Templates.Body:
Hello {EmployeeName},

We inform you that your access to application '{AppName}' (previous role: '{RoleName}') has been revoked.

If you believe this is an error, please contact the system administrator or the IT team.

Regards,
The {FromName} Team
